outlook.title: Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low pressure located several hundred miles southwest of southwestern Mexico are becoming better organized. Gradual development of this system is likely, and a tropical depression is expected to form later this week while the system moves generally west-northwest

outlook.title: Well South of the Southern Tip of Baja California
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure is forecast to develop several hundred miles south of the southern tip of Baja California this weekend or early next week. Some slow development is possible as this system moves generally west-northwestward.
